title: Countdown Timer Methodology
overview: Countdown timers calculate remaining time to a future event with precision down to seconds. Real-time display requires accounting for computational delays and timezone accuracy.

methods.name: Standard Countdown
methods.description: Calculate days, hours, minutes, seconds until a target date/time.

formula.name: Time Remaining
formula.expression:
Remaining = Target DateTime - Current DateTime
Days = floor(Remaining / 86400)
Hours = floor((Remaining % 86400) / 3600)
Minutes = floor((Remaining % 3600) / 60)
Seconds = Remaining % 60

footnotes: Browser timestamps may drift - sync with server for precision
Account for timezone of target event vs user timezone
